title: Creamy Tofu Bake
description: A simple and satisfying dish that combines the creaminess of light sauce with the versatility of tofu, all in a delicious bake.
instructions: Cut the tofu into small cubes and place in a baking dish.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the light sauce and creamy sauce.
Pour the sauce mixture over the tofu and make sure it's fully coated.
Add the bake mix to the sauce and stir well.
Add water as needed to achieve the right consistency.
Bake in the preheated oven for 25-30 minutes or until the sauce is bubbly and the tofu is golden brown.
